gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-sc: Neon-tube circles meet bookish refinement. Comfortaa's stretched, rounded letters sit over Noto Serif SC, whose gentle thick-thin modulation gives the page a literary backbone.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-serif-tc: Rounded, friendly, almost glowing. Comfortaa holds one steady pressure from start to finish, while Noto Serif TC, a text serif, adds a faint modulation that feels traditional and settled.
gen-comfortaa-gf-petrona: Dignified, with a wink. Comfortaa's tube-smooth lines and Petrona's tempered thick-thin strokes sit together easily, one playful and geometric, the other editorial and quietly serious.
gen-comfortaa-gf-poly: Poly reads bookish and literary, with slight thinning at the curves. Comfortaa does its best work as a smooth, tube-like display line, while Poly, a text serif, does its best in running text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-quattrocento: Round, glassy letters up top, traditional serif forms beneath, with daylight visible inside every curve. Comfortaa's uniform joins against Quattrocento's sturdy hairlines make the pair memorable.
gen-comfortaa-gf-radley: Authoritative Radley text sits under a hollow, glass-tube heading in Comfortaa, and the letters keep a steady, unhurried feel. Then comes Radley, a text serif, whose restrained thick-thin rhythm lets the eye slip through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sahitya: Sahitya reads bookish and traditional, its thin strokes barely lighter than the thick ones. Sahitya, a serif, moves through a long page with a mild shift from heavy stems to lighter curves, never tiring.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Sawarabi Mincho brings classic refinement, its terminals cut well short of the bowl and its weight shifts measured like thread against yarn. But Comfortaa excels at stress-free, round display lines, while Sawarabi Mincho, a text serif, excels at quiet, refined text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sedan: Sedan carries a bookish, authoritative voice, with mellow stroke weights and terminals held far from the stroke body. Try it comfortably sized beneath Comfortaa's ring-like letters.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sedan-sc: Looped, tubular, friendly. Comfortaa keeps every line at one thickness in any direction, while Sedan SC, a classic serif, lets its thin strokes drop to half the weight of its thick ones.
